title: Vietnamese Braised Pork Chops
description: A flavorful and tender dish that combines the richness of pork chops with the bold flavors of Vietnamese braising sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the pork chops and cook until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
3. Remove the pork chops from the pot and set aside.
4. In the same pot, add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
5. Add the braised curry sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to the pot.
6. Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
7. Return the pork chops to the pot and cover with a lid.
8. Transfer the pot to the oven and braise for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until the pork chops are tender.
9. Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the coconut milk.
10. Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
11. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve over rice or noodles.
